segments.en: I am not interested in saying the details.
Have you been married for a long time?
It has been three or four months.
Who all are there at home?
You said you are married, right?
My husband is outside, in Abu Dhabi.
Did you try for any job?
How long has it been since you got married?
I have been married for two years.
My wife is a civil engineer, she has a job.
What did you come to say, wife?
Only the wife has a job, right?
Okay, okay. What is the name?
You don't want to tell me the details of the store?
I am just asking how to come to Ernakulam.
Is the shop in Ernakulam itself?
Do you have an Instagram ID?
Not for the shop. I have one. I do a sports-related channel. I have about 10k plus followers.
Yes, I get paid from Facebook and YouTube.
Yes, from Facebook and YouTube, I get paid.
So, we only get paid if we have a certain number of followers and views on Facebook, right?
Yes, that is it. It should cross 5k, then 30 million should be hit. I have 8.5k on Facebook.
If we have 5k followers, will the payment start?
Not exactly, there are some conditions. Like, within so many days, and there are many things like that. We have to post stories, and many other things before it gets monetized.
It should be our own content.
There are many things, not just like that.
Nothing in particular, just my photos and videos.
Is it monetized? Is content monetization on?
I don't know about these things.
Ah, you have to take the professional dashboard and all.
No, in that... now... if content monetization is on, you will get paid for everything you post.
I don't know how to do all that.
It is not just that, you need to have the dashboard and all. Since you have followers, I am not saying the details because I don't want to.
No, no, it is only on Facebook. On Instagram, I have followers, but...
You don't get paid on Instagram. You get paid on Facebook.
I know Instagram doesn't pay. But if we get collaborations, it is different.
Yes, that is it. And we get more messages for promotions on Instagram.
Yes, I get more on Facebook than on YouTube.
Have you done any collaborations on Instagram?
Yes, I do it often. Collaborations are always done.
So, do you get paid when you do that?
If someone calls us, for example, if they call to post a live, my rate is 6000 rupees.
Then they ask for some shorts, I take the shorts and...
We don't buy anything for that. 6000 rupees is for posting a live on YouTube.
Live means you have to post it then and there.
Yes, YouTube live, it is ongoing, right?
Apart from that, if you want to do any videos...
I do promotions for shops. Like small shorts, I do that often. We can get paid for that if we know them. If not, I have earned 15 rupees for that.
15, 15, 12, I get at least that much.
I don't buy from people I know, I only buy for 3 or 4 rupees.
I am trying to make my Instagram like that, but if I post continuously, only then will I get it on Instagram.
Yes, you should post continuously. There is no other way.
Yes, that is it. I have only two phones, and I edit and post whenever I get time. It is beneficial for me, I get paid.
We feel like posting. If we post for seven days, we get an extra incentive of 50 dollars, and 5000 rupees.
50 dollars, oh, is it like that?
What do you post on Facebook?
Sports-related, I post the same. Now I am doing women's cricket, so I post reels of that.
Oh, I have kept all that continuously. I have content to post.
Yes, that is there. But I want to post, but I am not getting it.
If you post photos, you will get paid, but that...
You will get paid for photos. For everything you post, you will get paid.
If you post photos, you will get paid for everything.
Yes, I know that, but I should post continuously, right?
Yes, I post my photos and videos on Instagram continuously.
I had a private account until recently. It has been three or four months since I made it public.
I get more followers and views now. I get good views when I post.
You have to know if it is monetized or not.
How to know if it is monetized or not?
It is hard to explain like this. You have to see the professional dashboard and go to the monetization option.
You have to know that, only then it will work.
If you give interest, it will...
I have done all those things.
I don't look at it, and since I don't know about it, I don't pay attention or look at it.
I said that, it is a program where you get good money.
Yes, if you look at it, it will work.
No, I am looking at it.
I think, since I don't know that, I think if I get some views and reach on Instagram, I will get some collaborations.
Collaborations are something we get sometimes. If you do Facebook properly, you can make good earnings.
I don't know how to do that.
Can you hear me? What did you say? I didn't hear.
Then I will tell you about this.
If you are interested, I will tell you.
If you are interested, I will tell you.
If you are interested, I will tell you, I said.
If you are interested, I will...
What, I didn't hear. It is not clearing.
If you are interested, I will tell you everything and set it up.
I don't have any problem with you telling me.
No, I can't say it in this. Either give me your number, or take my number and call me.
I am not interested in giving my number. What is your Instagram ID?
My name is 22 Yards by JP. You can check that.
22 is the number. 22 space Yards, Y A R D S, space by, space JP.
